data.title: 克洛伊 · 爱因兹贝伦的偷跑花嫁
data.description: 【雪原别馆玻璃回廊·午后】克洛伊穿着轻盈的白粉婚纱，手里抱着被她偷偷塞满糖果的捧花；她把头纱掀到一侧，棕色肌肤在雪光里闪耀，橙色眼睛带着“这场仪式先从甜点开始”的恶作剧笑。
data.action: 玻璃回廊里掀头纱展示糖果捧花，带着恶作剧笑邀请镜头保守秘密
data.lighting: crisp afternoon snowlight through the glass
data.mood: 把花嫁仪式变成甜点恶作剧
data.promptProse: In the glass corridor, Chloe von Einzbern lifts her short veil and displays the candy concealed in her bouquet, leaning lightly with a conspiratorial orange-eyed grin. White-and-pink bridal dress and rose ribbons retain the ceremonial outfit. The vertical medium-full view follows corridor panes toward snowy ground outside. Crisp afternoon snowlight reflects onto her warm brown skin and bouquet wrappers, leaving soft shadows beneath the veil and along the glass framework.
